## Description

Buys the underlying or a close proxy and sells an overpriced future (or reverses) when basis differs from financing, dividends/storage and expiry costs.

## Where it may fit

Positive or negative basis mispricing when funding, borrow or inventory constraints create a tradeable spread.

## Vehicles

Index, commodity, fixed-income and crypto basis funds; institutional relative value.

## Required data

Spot/underlying and futures prices, financing, dividends/storage, borrow availability, expiry schedule, margin and fees.

## Caveats

Basis is not risk-free until legs, financing, delivery and collateral are considered; physical commodities add storage and delivery complexity.
